basic_info.description: Live in San Francisco for under $300k! Not a BMR - best deal in SF! Situated in an ideal Inner Sunset location, 1339 16th Avenue No. 6 is a stylish studio home, tucked away in a boutique 6-unit building that exudes San Francisco charm. This private and secluded retreat offers a beautifully renovated kitchen and bathroom, high ceilings, with modern finishes throughout. The sleek, full-kitchen features a dishwasher, cooktop, and built-in laundry for convenience. Pamper yourself in the luxurious, spa-like bathroom with custom tiling and a generous walk-in shower. With a stellar 96 Walk Score in the thriving Inner Sunset, indulge in easy access to Golden Gate Park, trendy dining & shopping spots on Irving St, and the N Judah MUNI line for seamless commuting. Welcome to your new home!
